events.title: RBI MPC hikes repo 25 bp to 5.50%, stance to calibrated tightening (7 Oct 2026)
events.description: First RBI hike since 2023. Repo 5.25% -> 5.50% (held at 5.25% on 5 Aug 2026). Stance moved from neutral to 'calibrated tightening'; Governor Malhotra said near-term rate cuts are 'off the table'. Rate vote reported unanimous (secondary source); minutes (21 Oct) show 2 members opposed the stance change and flag more hikes but wariness of an aggressive cycle. Drivers cited: broadening inflation (oil, onions, monsoon), 7.8% Q1 GDP, global tightening. RBI raised FY27 GDP forecast to 7.1% (from 6.7%). RBI also tightened liquidity (see EV_RBI_LIQUIDITY_BOND_SELLOFF_OCT26).
events.what_already_moved: 6 Oct: banks in green, autos and realty dipped on hike expectations. 10y G-sec 7.40% on 12 Oct, >7.45% on 21 Oct, 7.44% on 3 Nov. Nifty had an 8-week losing streak before the decision; Nifty50 ~24,460 on 5 Nov (+7.4% in 1 month per factor_state.md). Rupee +1% to 95.76 on 12 Oct after RBI dollar-demand curbs.

entry_shocks.note: immediate repricing; the larger yield run-up is booked in EV_RBI_LIQUIDITY_BOND_SELLOFF_OCT26 to avoid double count

SBI Research sees 6.75-7.0% by March 2027; another report sees 7.25-7.35% in November. Size of the current surplus not retrieved (missing information).

events.title: Rupee at 95-96/USD and heavy RBI FX defence; reserves fall ~US$55bn from peak
events.description: Rupee fell past 95/USD on 9 Sep, touched ~95.99 on 25 Sep (near record lows) amid oil, weak foreign flows and a narrow India-US yield spread. RBI intervened in spot and forwards: net short forward book reached a record ~US$200bn in August; weekly reserves fell a record US$18.34bn to US$757.46bn (w/e 25 Sep), US$734.60bn (2 Oct), US$726.03bn (9 Oct), US$721bn (16 Oct), US$719.75bn (23 Oct; seventh straight weekly fall). Implied peak ~US$775.8bn (18 Sep; derived: 757.46+18.34). RBI sold ~US$18.2bn in October, the most this year; Reuters (15 Oct) estimates it has spent half of a US$140bn capital-flow haul. On 12 Oct RBI moved to curb dollar demand. Rupee recovered to 94.58 on 5 Nov as crude fell and US midterms weakened the dollar; Reuters (4 Nov) still sees risk of resumed slide on weak inflows.
events.what_already_moved: USD/INR 94.49 on 5 Nov: -1.1% since 1 Jun (i.e. ~95.5 on 1 Jun), -1.9% over 1 month, +6.5% over 12 months (factor_state.md). Reserves -~7% from derived peak.

entry_shocks.note: net move since 1 Jun is -1.1% (=-0.37 SSU) because RBI defended; the peak leg was roughly +0.2 SSU above 1 Jun

events.title: 57th GST Council (8 Oct 2026): no rate change; process reforms (refund automation, decriminalisation)
events.description: Council avoided mid-year rate changes and instead approved structural reforms: automated refunds (90% ITC refund automation), no arrests/lower prosecution and general penalty changes, easier registration, litigation reduction. Finance Ministry sources (8 Oct): GST rate changes to take effect only once a year, from 1 April. Backdrop (model knowledge): GST 2.0 slab simplification effective 22 Sep 2025 boosted consumption; gross GST Rs 2.31 lakh crore in Oct 2026 (+22.9% y/y), partly import-driven (CBIC disputes 'apples and oranges' comparisons). Opposition states sought compensation. Possible future items: mobile phones 18% review, flat 5% for renewable EPC.
